London-based startup First Concepts , an AI-powered workspace for early-stage creative work
First Concepts, a London, UK-based AI-powered workspace for early-stage creative work
First Concepts aims to address this challenge by introducing an AI layer that sits above existing tools and coordinates leading AI models through a shared context and “taste” framework.

The product is structured around three core components. A Creative DNA engine captures and learns individual and brand-specific preferences. A unified interface treats context as the central reference point for all creative work. A tool-agnostic infrastructure connects various creative applications while ensuring coherence across outputs.
